rows.commentary: 4.6: Jasprit Bumrah pushes a full delivery angling into off stump, meeting a resolute forward defensive block from Rachin Ravindra.
5.1: Anshul Kamboj squares Henry Nicholls up with away-movement from a good length, inducing a thick edge that drops short of third slip.
5.2: Anshul Kamboj offers Henry Nicholls a welcome reprieve, pitching a full ball well outside the off stump that is left alone.
5.3: Anshul Kamboj goes wide of the crease to deliver a rising, away-swinging short-of-length ball outside off which Henry Nicholls watches past.
5.4: Anshul Kamboj strays down leg with a length delivery that Henry Nicholls misses on the flick, scurrying off the thigh pad for four leg byes to the fine-leg boundary.
5.5: Anshul Kamboj serves up a full one outside off, nicely guided past gully with an intentionally opened face by Henry Nicholls to find the vacant third-man fence for four.
5.6: Anshul Kamboj steps over the front line while slinging a wide delivery well outside off that Henry Nicholls leaves alone.
5.6: Anshul Kamboj pitches full on middle stump, checked defensively toward mid-off by Henry Nicholls with minimal timing.
6.1: Jasprit Bumrah strays onto the pads with a length ball, allowing Rachin Ravindra to step forward and flick it behind square for a racing boundary at deep backward square-leg.
6.2: Jasprit Bumrah asks rigorous questions on the fifth-stump channel, sharply beating Rachin Ravindra's forward prod with late away-seam movement.
6.3: Jasprit Bumrah attacks middle and off with a fullish length, securely blocked back down the pitch by Rachin Ravindra behind a straight bat.
6.4: Jasprit Bumrah unleashes a searing 141kph short ball that swerves wickedly, forcing Rachin Ravindra to gracefully arch his back and sway out of harm's way.
6.5: Jasprit Bumrah pushes a full delivery into middle and off, and Rachin Ravindra strides forward to dead-bat it toward cover.
6.6: Jasprit Bumrah angles one short of a length outside off that seams away, inviting Rachin Ravindra to watch it sail past.
7.1: Anshul Kamboj floats a fullish delivery well wide of off stump, watching it depart untouched.
7.2: Anshul Kamboj fires from wide of the crease, pitching back of a length outside off to nip back sharply as Henry Nicholls shoulders arms.
7.3: Anshul Kamboj digs it in short of a length outside off, where Henry Nicholls steps back to pat it to backward point while shouting a firm refusal.
7.4: Anshul Kamboj drops short on middle, and Henry Nicholls jumps back to whip it aerially past mid-wicket, eluding Jaiswal's desperate chase for four.
7.5: Anshul Kamboj offers a full width outside off that tails away, smartly left alone by the batter.
7.6: Anshul Kamboj pitches back of a length outside off, and Henry Nicholls rocks back to punch it straight to the short cover fielder.
17.4: Akash Deep angles it in on off, and Henry Nicholls gets right behind the line to block.
17.5: Akash Deep delivers a short ball outside off that Henry Nicholls watches sail through.
17.6: Henry Nicholls goes back to tuck a short of length delivery, getting a thick inside edge that drops safely just short of Akash Deep's followthrough.

18.1: Prasidh Krishna goes over the wicket with a full delivery outside off, driven sharply by Rachin Ravindra to Kamboj, whose one-handed direct hit at the bowler's end narrowly misses as the batter slides his bat in.
18.2: Prasidh Krishna serves up a short of length ball angling away, allowing Henry Nicholls to drift onto the back foot and cut it wide of gully.
18.3: Henry Nicholls flashes away from his body at a short of length delivery, fortunate not to nick it behind off Prasidh Krishna.
18.4: Prasidh Krishna extracts rising bounce from a short of length outside off, left alone by Henry Nicholls.
18.5: Henry Nicholls gets forward and leaves alone a full delivery angled away outside off by Prasidh Krishna.
18.6: Prasidh Krishna fires a full ball on middle, pushed off the inner half by Henry Nicholls toward mid-wicket.
19.1: Akash Deep strikes as Rachin Ravindra slashes at a short of length delivery outside off, edging behind to Rishabh Pant to bring an end to his innings.
19.2: Akash Deep hurries Daryl Mitchell with a 137kph bumper, forcing the batter to yank his head out of the way.
19.3: Daryl Mitchell steps forward to a short of length delivery from Akash Deep, closing the face to nudge a quick single wide of Jaiswal.
19.4: Akash Deep digs this short of a length outside off, and Henry Nicholls hangs back to punch it firmly towards mid-off.
19.5: Dharmasena emphatically waves away a booming lbw appeal as Akash Deep's angled delivery strikes Nicholls high above the kneeroll.
19.6: Akash Deep pushes a full ball in on off stump, and Nicholls steps forward to present a straight bat in defense.
21.1: Akash Deep attacks the off stump with a probing good-length delivery, safely dead-batted by Henry Nicholls advancing forward.
21.2: Akash Deep drops it short of a length outside off, allowing Henry Nicholls to shift onto the back foot and nudge it securely to mid-on.
21.3: Akash Deep floats a full one onto middle, which Henry Nicholls pounces on with a forward press, piercing the gap wide of mid-wicket for a comfortable couple as Bumrah gives chase.
21.4: Akash Deep targets the fifth-stump channel with a full delivery, inducing a thick inside edge off Henry Nicholls' forward prod that skitters away to deep backward square-leg for a single.
21.5: Akash Deep generates lift from a short of length outside off, beating Tom Blundell's back-foot defense as the ball zips perilously close to the outside edge.
21.6: Akash Deep extracts a thick outside edge from Tom Blundell's back-foot prod, racing past a despairing dive from Jurel at gully while Padikkal retrieves it deep for three brisk runs.
22.1: Jasprit Bumrah floats it full and inviting outside off at 138.8kph, and Tom Blundell strides forward to deadbat the delivery safely toward the gully fielder.
22.2: Jasprit Bumrah angles one in from a short of length outside off before it holds its line, prompting Tom Blundell to comfortably shoulder arms.
22.3: Jasprit Bumrah angles a sharp inducer into Tom Blundell's thigh pad, escaping Richard Illingworth's LBW appeal as the batter misses his flick on the way down.
22.4: Jasprit Bumrah fires a short-of-length delivery past the outside edge, leaving Tom Blundell to leave it alone as Pant safely gathers near his face.
22.5: Jasprit Bumrah serves up a full delivery angled into middle, which Tom Blundell neatly clips away past mid-on to collect two runs.

22.6: Jasprit Bumrah finds vicious extra bounce and inward nip from a length, rapping Tom Blundell high on the back leg as he misses his back-foot defense, carrying to the cordon to signal lunch on the opening day.
23.1: Anshul Kamboj overpitches into the pads, allowing Nicholls to clip it away with soft hands all the way to the fine leg boundary.
32.1: Jasprit Bumrah hunts from round the wicket, pinning a channel outside off that Nicholls wisely watches pass to the keeper.
32.2: Henry Nicholls gropes at a testing sixth-stump teaser from Bumrah, terribly fortunate to withdraw the blade without nicking off.
32.3: Bumrah darts one back from a shortish length, catching Nicholls's inner edge to trickle toward vacant square leg for a single.
32.4: Glenn Phillips retreats securely onto the back foot, meeting Bumrah's tight length delivery right in line.
32.5: Extra bounce rears off the surface from Bumrah, but Phillips handles it deftly with soft hands toward backward point.
32.6: Bumrah fires it full into middle, and Phillips strides forward to tickle a flick left of mid-wicket.
33.1: Prasidh Krishna targets a full outside off line, inviting Nicholls forward for a solid defensive push.
33.2: Nicholls nudges Krishna's short-of-length delivery off the inner half, sparking a slight mix-up before scampering safely.
33.3: Phillips gets forward to Krishna's angled good-length delivery, opening the bat face to steer it wide of cover.
33.4: Krishna angles in from round the wicket into the channel, leaving Nicholls untroubled as he shoulders arms.
33.5: Pitching full outside off once more, Krishna watches Nicholls comfortably ignore another delivery.
33.6: Nicholls pulls Krishna through mid-wicket, and electric running from Phillips safely converts the stroke into a frantic triple.
34.1: Akash Deep targets the back of a length outside off, and Henry Nicholls retreats to push it solidly back to the bowler.
34.2: Akash Deep searches for the wide expanses outside the tramlines, offering a full delivery that Henry Nicholls watches sail past without a stroke.
34.3: Akash Deep drops it back on a length outside off, prompting Henry Nicholls onto the back foot to steer it safely just to the left of the bowler.
34.4: Akash Deep pitches it full and angling into the channel, where Henry Nicholls strides forward to launch a crisp off-drive straight to mid-off from the sweet spot.
34.5: Akash Deep angles in a sharp delivery from wide of the crease that seams away off the surface, tempting Henry Nicholls into a hesitant flirt that beats the outside edge.
34.6: Akash Deep delivers a tight good-length ball slanted into off stump, forcing Henry Nicholls to shuffle across and comfortably dead-bat it back down the pitch.
46.5: Anshul Kamboj digs this length ball in, extracting extra bounce that forces Glenn Phillips to release his bottom hand and steer it past backward point for a single.
46.6: Anshul Kamboj bangs this one short down the leg side, squeezing out a rare dot ball against two busy batters.
47.1: Washington Sundar tosses a full delivery just outside off stump, met by Glenn Phillips who covers the line to block.
47.2: Washington Sundar keeps bowling to Glenn Phillips, who plays this one into the short leg fielder.
47.3: Washington Sundar slides another delivery in, knocked towards short mid-wicket by Glenn Phillips.
47.4: Washington Sundar attacks the stumps with a full delivery, watchfully tucked away to the on-side by Glenn Phillips.
47.5: Washington Sundar keeps a straight line, defended towards mid-wicket by Glenn Phillips.
47.6: Washington Sundar completes a maiden over as Glenn Phillips executes yet another defensive block.
48.1: Anshul Kamboj attacks the stumps with a short delivery, prompting Nicholls to hop and defend.
48.2: Anshul Kamboj delivers a short of length ball where Nicholls hangs back and defends, having second-guessed his shot selection entirely.
48.3: Anshul Kamboj digs it in short, allowing Nicholls an easy leave.
48.4: Anshul Kamboj targets the leg stump with a short delivery, met by Nicholls hopping on the crease to defend.
48.5: Kamboj probes from round the wicket, pinning Nicholls back to counter a sharp lifting delivery outside off.
48.6: Kamboj finds late inward seam to finish the session, easily repelled off the back foot as tea arrives on day one.
54.5: Jasprit Bumrah pushes past the good length at 137.8ks, and Glenn Phillips plays late, smothering the ball close to his frame.
54.6: Jasprit Bumrah delivers a 135.5ks full ball angling inward, which Glenn Phillips steps forward to push toward mid-on.
55.1: Washington Sundar drifts a fuller delivery in, allowing Nicholls to clip it toward mid-on and sprint across for a quick single.
55.2: Washington Sundar slides one into the leg stump at 89.8ks, prompting Glenn Phillips to work it across toward mid-wicket.
55.3: Washington Sundar floats a full 89.7ks delivery around off, and Glenn Phillips meets it with a firm drive straight to mid-off.
55.4: Washington Sundar lands a 92.9ks fuller delivery near off stump, met securely by Glenn Phillips in a textbook forward defense.
55.5: Washington Sundar tosses up a 91.6ks delivery, inviting Glenn Phillips forward to dead-bat the ball straight back.
55.6: Washington Sundar attacks the stumps at 91.3ks, and Glenn Phillips drops back to turn the ball neatly into the leg side.
56.1: Jasprit Bumrah targets the hip line, forcing Nicholls to hop on his toes and tuck the ball toward mid-wicket.
56.2: Jasprit Bumrah unleashes a searing 136ks yorker at off stump, jammed away near the boot by Nicholls with lightning reflexes.
56.3: Jasprit Bumrah offers a fuller 138.1ks delivery outside off, which Nicholls watches sail past as he lifts his bat to let it go.
56.4: Jasprit Bumrah digs in a 135.2ks short ball angling in, allowing Nicholls to hop on one leg and pull it backward of square.
56.5: Bumrah fires in a searing 135.3-kph near-yorker that Phillips sharply staves back down the track.
56.6: Bumrah seeks a tighter channel on 133.9 kph, dropping it near off for a solid defensive block, only to find the umpire's arm stretching out for an overstep.
56.6: Bumrah oversteps once more on a 134.5-kph delivery outside off, forcing Phillips to stab it cautiously toward backward point as the fielders are abruptly recalled.
56.6: Bumrah offers width full outside off, allowing Phillips to ride the bounce and punch a controlled two runs in front of square.
68.4: Anshul Kamboj delivers a sharp short ball that Glenn Phillips forcefully pulls away into the deep backward square leg region for a couple of runs.
68.5: Anshul Kamboj tests Glenn Phillips with a length delivery angled in on off stump, which the batter comfortably gets behind and defends from the crease.
68.6: Anshul Kamboj keeps it tight on a short of length, allowing Glenn Phillips to comfortably negotiate the delivery as the over draws to a close.
69.1: Prasidh Krishna digs it in short on the leg stump, and Nicholls calmly watches it fly past him without offering a stroke.
69.2: Nicholls plays an inside edge onto his pad, scampers through for a single to complete a sensational, gritty Test hundred amid emotional celebrations from his teammates and family.
69.3: Prasidh Krishna bangs in another short delivery close to off stump, forcing Glenn Phillips to gracefully duck underneath it.
69.4: Prasidh Krishna fires a short and wide delivery outside off at 133 clicks, which Glenn Phillips wisely chooses to ignore.
69.5: Prasidh Krishna probes with a shortish delivery angling into off, and Phillips stands tall to fend it away with soft hands.
69.6: Prasidh Krishna digs in a rapid bouncer around leg at 136.4 kilometers per hour, requiring Phillips to bend his back and let it sail over.
70.1: Washington Sundar tosses it up and drifts it in, prompting Nicholls to step forward and solidly block it.
70.2: Washington Sundar floats a flighted delivery close to off stump, which Nicholls safely defends toward the off side.
70.3: Washington Sundar comes from round the wicket with a flighted delivery that Nicholls pushes straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
70.4: Washington Sundar delivers, Nicholls shifts across the crease to clip it toward short mid-wicket, and they scamper through for a sharp single.
79.4: Anshul Kamboj offers a full length, and Glenn Phillips meets it solidly with a straight bat.
79.5: The short delivery climbs rapidly on Glenn Phillips, who averts his gaze before forcing the pull down to backward square leg.
79.6: Anshul Kamboj digs it in short again, and Glenn Phillips pulls it securely toward backward square leg.
80.1: With three slips and a gully waiting, Jasprit Bumrah pushes it full and away, allowing Nicholls to lean forward and drive it cleanly through the cover region for four.
80.2: Jasprit Bumrah dials in his outswinger on a good length outside off, and Nicholls stays compact to defend.
80.3: Jasprit Bumrah hunts for the inswinger but errs completely down the leg-side.
80.4: Jasprit Bumrah drifts one full and away outside the off stump, prompting Nicholls to offer no shot.
80.5: Jasprit Bumrah extracts movement away from the off stump, and Nicholls holds his ground to block from the crease.
80.6: Jasprit Bumrah unleashes a searing inswinging yorker, forcing Nicholls to jam his bat down desperately and survive the final delivery.
81.1: Anshul Kamboj attacks the stumps with a full delivery, and Glenn Phillips drives it cleanly to mid-off.
81.2: Anshul Kamboj strays short on the pads with the new ball, allowing Glenn Phillips to clip it behind square for a pair of runs.
81.3: Anshul Kamboj serves up a fullish line outside off, and Glenn Phillips watches it sail past.
81.4: Anshul Kamboj launches a short of length outside off; Glenn Phillips unruffled, lets it go past the stumps.
81.5: Anshul Kamboj again bowls a short outside off; Glenn Phillips defends with a crisp backlift, denying any runs.

81.6: Kamboj drops full into the line of middle and leg, pushed cleanly away toward mid-on where Phillips calls immediately and scampers through for one to seal a defiant ninety-four at the close of day one.
88.4: Anshul Kamboj delivers short of length outside off, allowing Glenn Phillips to glide it off the back foot through backward point for a single.
88.5: Anshul Kamboj attacks the middle stump with extra bounce and a sharp nip-backer, beating Henry Nicholls's tuck to race away past the slips for four leg byes.
88.6: Anshul Kamboj digs it in on a short length at the stumps, where Henry Nicholls plays off the back foot to mid-on and calls out a sharp wait.
89.1: Akash Deep targets a short of length outside off, permitting Glenn Phillips to punch off the back foot into the vacant point region for one run.
89.2: Akash Deep comes from round the wicket on a fullish length outside off, watching Henry Nicholls offer a clean leave.
89.3: Akash Deep fires it full and just outside off, inviting another watchful leave from Henry Nicholls.
89.4: Akash Deep probes the fourth-stump line on a short of length as Henry Nicholls shuffles across to shoulder arms.
89.5: Akash Deep drifts it fullish and outside off, drawing Henry Nicholls across his off-stump before letting it pass.
89.6: Akash Deep caps off a probing over with a fuller length outside off, comfortably ignored by Henry Nicholls.
90.1: Anshul Kamboj shapes one away on a full length outside off, ignored entirely by Glenn Phillips.
90.2: Anshul Kamboj tests off-stump with a tight short of length, easily tapped by Glenn Phillips off the back foot into the vacant point area for a single.
90.3: Anshul Kamboj hurls down a short delivery into the body, rapping Henry Nicholls high on the pad as he attempts a back-foot pull.
90.4: Anshul Kamboj tests Henry Nicholls with a sharp delivery climbing near off stump, met with a solid back-foot defense.
90.5: Anshul Kamboj targets the channel outside off, and Henry Nicholls watches the rising ball sail harmlessly past.
90.6: Anshul Kamboj drops it back of a length outside off, allowing Henry Nicholls to rock back and punch cleanly to cover.
91.1: Akash Deep angles one far outside off, drawing an untroubled leave from Glenn Phillips.
91.2: Akash Deep lands it wide of the sixth stump, watching as Glenn Phillips easily ignores the movement away.
100.2: Jasprit Bumrah targets the channel with a back-of-a-length delivery, and Henry Nicholls retreats to push it firmly toward the cover region.
100.3: Jasprit Bumrah tests the middle stump from a back of a length, allowing Henry Nicholls to step back and steer a single into the vacant mid-wicket space.
100.4: Jasprit Bumrah serves a testing good-length delivery outside off that Nathan Smith watches pass, only for the ball to sharply nip back through to Rishabh Pant.
100.5: Jasprit Bumrah offers plenty of width on a good length, and Nathan Smith easily decides to offer no stroke.
100.6: Jasprit Bumrah digs it in short on the leg stump, forcing Nathan Smith onto the back foot to tuck it away straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
101.1: Prasidh Krishna comes from round the wicket to pitch it fullish around off, meeting a resolute forward defensive push from Henry Nicholls.
101.2: Prasidh Krishna drifts a full delivery onto the pads, which Henry Nicholls presents a stride forward to flick down to deep backward square-leg.
101.3: Prasidh Krishna clocks a short of length outside off, leaving Nathan Smith completely unbothered as he lets it travel through.
101.4: Prasidh Krishna lands a good-length ball that catches Nathan Smith hesitant on the front foot, stinging the bat before rolling meekly to the bowler's right.
101.5: Prasidh Krishna shapes one back in full toward off, drawing a forward drive from Nathan Smith that takes a thick inside edge and trickles to mid-on.
101.6: Prasidh Krishna attacks the corridor of uncertainty with a fullish length, inviting Nathan Smith to leave it alone once more.
102.1: Jasprit Bumrah digs a short one outside off, prompting Henry Nicholls to arch his back and smoothly sway out of harm's way.
102.2: Jasprit Bumrah digs it in short and angles it wide of off, leaving Nicholls untroubled as he watches it sail through.
102.3: Jasprit Bumrah targets the stumps with a sharp 136.5kph bumper, forcing Henry Nicholls to duck smartly underneath.
102.4: Jasprit Bumrah takes pace off with an off-cutter, drawing Henry Nicholls forward to block comfortably toward mid-off.
102.5: Jasprit Bumrah lets out an audible grunt as he fires another 136.1kph short ball down leg, evading the ducking Henry Nicholls.
102.6: Jasprit Bumrah unleashes the yorker outside off, squeezed by Henry Nicholls into the turf as KL takes the bump-ball at second slip.
105.3: Prasidh Krishna delivers full and angled into middle, allowing Henry Nicholls to step forward and nudge it towards mid-on for a single.
105.4: Prasidh Krishna targets a short-of-length zone outside off, prompting Nathan Smith to watch it sail past.
105.5: Prasidh Krishna drifts a full delivery into off stump, met by a slight shuffle and solid defense from Nathan Smith straight to mid-on.
105.6: Prasidh Krishna drops it short on off, forcing Nathan Smith to duck underneath the trajectory.
106.1: Washington Sundar tosses up a full delivery on off with drift, answered by a forward defensive stroke from Henry Nicholls.
106.2: Washington Sundar fires a flat, good-length ball outside off, which Henry Nicholls punches off the back foot past short cover for a single.
106.3: Washington Sundar floats one full on off with drift, and Nathan Smith pushes forward to defend as they scamper through for a late single.
106.4: Washington Sundar offers a fuller length on middle that Henry Nicholls drives past the bowler's left hand to take a quick run at mid-on.
106.5: Washington Sundar tosses it up full on off, safely blocked back down the pitch by a forward-moving Nathan Smith.
106.6: Washington Sundar lands a good-length delivery outside off, and Nathan Smith gets across to defend into the empty silly mid-on space.
107.1: Prasidh Krishna digs it in short of a length on middle, where Henry Nicholls works it off the back foot toward mid-on for a single.
107.2: Prasidh Krishna bowls fullish outside off, pushed wide of gully by Nathan Smith before Jaiswal cuts it off with a sharp dive to his left.
107.3: Prasidh Krishna digs it in short down the leg side, and Henry Nicholls simply ducks beneath the trajectory.
107.4: Prasidh Krishna persists with the short ball attacking the stumps, forcing Nicholls to bend low out of harm's way.
107.5: Prasidh Krishna bangs another one in short near the hip, with Nicholls safely ducking as the lunch interval looms.
107.6: Prasidh Krishna unleashes one final short delivery to a heavily ringed leg-side field, which Nicholls watches sail past to signal lunch.
117.2: Akash Deep charges in to deliver a 135.5ks good length ball on off stump, which Nicholls gets firmly behind to block right back to the bowler.
117.3: Akash Deep fires a full delivery into the pads, safely flicked through mid-wicket by Nicholls as DDP swoops in sharply to restrict them to a single.
117.4: Akash Deep tests Jacob Duffy with a 137.8ks short-of-length delivery that stays low, allowing Duffy to block it down with ease.
117.5: Akash Deep serves up a 136.5ks fullish ball that Duffy aggressively drives in front of square, scrambling two runs to officially bring up the 350-run milestone for New Zealand.
117.6: Akash Deep unleashes a searing 138.5ks bouncer angled down leg, forcing Duffy to cleanly duck underneath the line.
118.1: Washington Sundar loops up an 87.6ks delivery short and outside off, neatly knocked through extra cover by Nicholls.
118.2: Washington Sundar tosses it up to meet a confident front-foot defense from Nicholls.
118.3: Washington Sundar drifts one in with the arm on a length, nudged away through mid-wicket by Nicholls for a single.
118.4: Washington Sundar overpitches his flighted delivery, inviting Jacob Duffy to stroke it down towards long-off for a run.
118.5: Washington Sundar flights it around off, and Nicholls drives it straight to the waiting hands of the extra cover fielder.
118.6: Washington Sundar slides a 94.6ks delivery in with the angle, catching Nicholls flush on the underside of his helmet grill as he crouches low to attempt a reverse paddle.

5.1: Jamieson feeds it full and angling inward, and Rahul leans forward to clip it square on the leg-side, waiting safely for it to cross the fielder before scrambling through for a single that finally gets him off the mark.
5.2: Jamieson hits a 134.8ks good length, slanting across to square Jaiswal right up as he pushes it straight back down the pitch.
5.3: Jamieson tempts Jaiswal with a fullish nip-away delivery that catches the outside edge, dying harmlessly in the turf well short of third slip.
5.4: Jamieson drops it short of a length outside the off-stump, allowing Jaiswal to watch it sail by untouched.
5.5: Jamieson draws the bat with a fullish ball angling and seaming away, leaving Jaiswal playing inside the line as it whistles past the outside edge.
5.6: Jamieson attacks the stumps on a short of length, meeting a resolute front-foot defense from Jaiswal.
6.1: Henry probes the stumps with a fullish length, kept out solidly off the front foot by KL.
6.2: Henry strays slightly short on the pads, and KL pounces by getting inside the line to whip it behind square for his very first boundary racing to the fence.
6.3: Henry pitches on a good length to nip one sharply back in, jammed straight into the hands of short mid-wicket by KL.

6.4: Matt Henry pins Rahul on the pads with a sharp nip-backer, unleashing a frantic appeal that goes unheeded by Kumar Dharmasena, only for the replays to flash three red lights and leave the bowler shaking his head in disbelief at a missed review.
6.5: Henry delivers a fullish ball, prompting Rahul to step purposefully down the pitch and meet it with a dead-straight bat.
6.6: Henry charges in at 134.2ks to bang it back of a length, leaving Rahul to master the bounce and steer it cleanly toward the covers.
7.1: Kyle Jamieson hits the 135ks mark with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery that rears up, forcing Yashasvi Jaiswal to raise his hands and watch it sail over.
7.2: Kyle Jamieson drifts a 132ks full ball into the leg-middle line, but Yashasvi Jaiswal resists the flick and meets it with a disciplined straight blade.
7.3: Kyle Jamieson offers width with a full delivery, inducing Yashasvi Jaiswal to slash hard and find an outside edge that slips right through Phillips' late-reacting hands at gully for four.
7.4: Kyle Jamieson targets the channel around off on a length, keeping Yashasvi Jaiswal pinned as he prods across to block it into the off-side.
7.5: Kyle Jamieson angles one in, allowing Yashasvi Jaiswal to play a soft, late defensive stroke beneath his eyes and scamper across for a sharp single.
7.6: Kyle Jamieson floats a fullish delivery around the off stump, prompting KL to stride forward and dead-bat it with authority.
13.5: Jacob Duffy probes with a good length delivery angling in, met by a forward-pressing block from Rahul.
13.6: Jacob Duffy bangs in a 138kph short ball that Rahul swivels on and pulls away to deep square leg for a single.
14.1: Kyle Jamieson attacks with a 135.1kph delivery fuller than good length, defended solidly by Rahul using pad and bat in unison.
14.2: Kyle Jamieson dangles a tempting full and wide offering that Rahul wisely ignores.
14.3: Kyle Jamieson targets the fifth stump at 134.9kph, prompting Rahul to prod across and leave it behind the protection of his pad.
14.4: Kyle Jamieson pushes a 136.3kph full ball close to off, smoothly blocked by Rahul towards mid-on.
14.5: Kyle Jamieson spears in a 136.2kph very full delivery, dug out neatly by Rahul into the vacant cover pocket for one.
14.6: Kyle Jamieson delivers a 134.6kph fullish ball around off, met by Jaiswal's forward prod and defense to mid-off.
15.1: Jacob Duffy sends down a 135.3kph nip-backer that Rahul defends with a thick inside edge running backward of square leg for a run.
15.2: Jacob Duffy pitches a 134kph fuller ball wide outside off, leaving Jaiswal an easy shoulder of arms.
15.3: Jacob Duffy fires in a 135.8kph delivery angling to the legs, cleanly tucked behind square by Jaiswal for a single.
15.4: Jacob Duffy induces a confident stride across from Rahul, who opens the bat face to steer a block towards point.
15.5: Jacob Duffy delivers a back-of-a-length ball that Rahul punches in front of square, charging through for a confident three runs with Jaiswal.
15.6: Jacob Duffy fires it short and wide across the left-hander, allowing Yashasvi Jaiswal to crouch and ramp it expertly over the slip cordon for four.
16.1: Kyle Jamieson targets the off stump at 133.4ks, and Rahul gets solidly behind the line to dead-bat it toward mid-on.
